name: Snowbombing
description: Week-long ski and electronic music festival in the Zillertal Alps
place: Mayrhofen (venues across the village and slopes)
price: n/a (packages with accommodation, from a 50 GBP deposit)
details:
27th edition of Snowbombing, a week of skiing by day and DJ sets in forests, igloos and clubs at night. Sold as packages with accommodation; early-bird packages are sold out, the site says the rest are "selling fast" and can be locked in with a 50 GBP deposit.

Line-up so far: Bicep (live), Fatboy Slim, 2manydjs, Basement Jaxx (DJ set), Groove Armada (DJ set), Andy C, Erol Alkan, Skream, Wilkinson, Jayda G and more.
note: Fatboy Slim (big beat), Bicep live, Basement Jaxx
